name: Switch 1 line - iPhone 18 Pro $0 with trade-in - Premium 2.0
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-22. Customer voice: polite, formal professional.
scripted_messages: Thank you. I'm looking to move one line over from T-Mobile and I'd like a clear picture of the cost before I commit. I'm in zip 75201 and I have no AT&T account at the moment. Your site lists the iPhone 18 Pro at $0 a month with an eligible trade-in, and I have an iPhone 15 Pro that's paid off, fully working, no cracks. What would my total monthly charge be with the Premium 2.0 plan? I'm only gathering numbers today and I'll place the order online myself, so chat is all I need.
Certainly, take all the time you need.
Thank you. So the phone itself is $0 a month for the 36 months, as long as the trade-in is accepted?
Understood. One small detail, what would my first bill look like with taxes, fees and any activation charge included?

That's a bit higher than I hoped for the first month, but I truly appreciate your patience and how clearly you explained everything. You've made the decision much easier, and I'll be giving you a very good rating.
No, that's all for today. Thank you again and have a wonderful evening!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the follow-up (a bill question usually gets 'please allow me a moment to calculate')
before message 6: agent: waiting message while calculating the bill
before message 7: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 8: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
